propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (e.g., --body-file, --body) as positional body argument instead of rejecting them, storing the flag string itself and discarding the intended content
the command exits with code 0 and produces no error output when a flag-looking argument is stored as body, making the silent data loss undetectable until the comment is read
positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) lack validation to reject or escape arguments beginning with hyphen
an escape hatch using -- (e.g., rebar comment <id> -- "-starts-with-dash") must allow legitimate hyphen-prefixed bodies to be stored without truncation or coercion
